description: Canonical fact layer — verified, source-backed claims about iZLET / Braća Kumerle. Each fact has a unique ID, classification, statement pair (HR/EN), sources, and verification state.

facts.statement_hr: Prvi dokumentirani javni nastup sastava iZLET održan je 23. ožujka 2007. u III. gimnaziji u Zagrebu.
facts.statement_en: The first documented public performance of iZLET took place on 23 March 2007 at III Gymnasium in Zagreb.

facts.statement_hr: iZLET je 2009. godine nastupom pjesme 'Ti si čudesna' na kompilaciji CMC Demo 2009. (Croatia Records) ostvario prvi verificirani fizički glazbeni zapis.
facts.statement_en: iZLET's track 'Ti Si Čudesna' appeared on the compilation CMC Demo 2009. released by Croatia Records, representing the band's first verified physical release.
iZLET was selected for inclusion on CMC Demo 2009., a curated compilation released by Croatia Records — establishing pre-debut professional selection status.
facts.impact: establishes pre-debut professional selection status for WP:GNG
